text:
Type: white ceramic plant pot
Use: holding a potted plant on a windowsill, shelf or table; living room, kitchen, home office, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: glazed white ceramic with embossed relief patterns
Colors: glossy white
Shape: small tapered pot with a slightly flared rim, comes in assorted reliefs such as vertical ribs, wavy lines, stacked rings and wide bands, simple and compact
Feel: fresh, clean, cheerful
Goes with: green plants, white shelves, light wood, colorful textiles; Scandinavian or minimalist rooms
